arXiv:2608.27449v1 [cs.SE] 27 Aug 2026

SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance

Dewu Zheng    Ruizhe Ye    Yanlin Wang\corresponding    Yang Ye    Hongyu Zhang    Ensheng Shi    Xilin Liu    Yuchi Ma    Jianxing Yu    Zibin Zheng
Abstract

To improve large language models’ ability to resolve real-world software issues, prior work has focused on constructing large-scale agent trajectory datasets and performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on successful trajectories. However, task success does not guarantee high-quality supervision: successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky steps. Directly using such trajectories for SFT can introduce noisy supervision and encourage models to imitate undesirable problem-solving behaviors. Therefore, we propose SWE-Prime, a multi-granularity, two-stage SFT data selection method that progressively filters training data at the trajectory and segment levels. Specifically, the first stage performs trajectory-level screening based on process quality, result quality, and data representativeness, selecting a high-quality and representative subset of successful trajectories. The second stage performs segment-level selection by grouping consecutive steps into semantic segments and assessing each segment based on its contribution to the final solution, learnability, and potential risks. During SFT, all segments remain in the sequence to preserve context, while only selected segments contribute to the loss computation. Experiments on SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified show that training on the 10% trajectory subset selected by SWE-Prime outperforms training on the full resolved dataset, yielding relative performance gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2%, respectively.

Introduction

Software issue resolution in real-world repositories has received growing attention in recent years (Jimenez et al. 2024; Pan et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2025b; Li et al. 2026). To improve coding agents’ performance on this long-horizon task, recent work has constructed large-scale software engineering datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) (Pan et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2025b; Jain et al. 2025; Guo et al. 2025; Zheng et al. 2023). For example, SWE-Gym derives executable tasks from real-world GitHub issues, while SWE-smith and R2E-Gym use synthetic data generation to scale task and trajectory collection. These approaches then perform SFT on successful trajectories identified through execution-based verification.

However, task success alone does not guarantee high-quality supervision (Uesato et al. 2022; Lightman et al. 2023; Xiong et al. 2024; Wang, Pradel, and Liu 2026). Successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky behaviors that should not be used as supervision for SFT (Chen et al. 2025b; Chen et al. 2025a; Wang et al. 2025a). Figure 1 illustrates this issue from three perspectives.

Outcome View. Existing work adopts an outcome-based view and thus retains both successful trajectories (Pan et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2025b; Jain et al. 2025; Guo et al. 2025).

Trajectory View. The trajectory view shows why Trajectory B is unsuitable for SFT through the following quality aspects:

  1. (1)

    Problem-solving Pattern: Standard problem-solving processes help models learn systematic issue-resolution behaviors during SFT (Chen, Ma, and Jiang 2026). Trajectory A follows an observe-edit-verify workflow, whereas Trajectory B modifies the code without prior exploration.

  2. (2)

    Tool Call Success Rate: Frequent tool failures introduce unreliable tool-use patterns into SFT supervision (Yang et al. 2025a). Trajectory B contains more such failures, whereas Trajectory A demonstrates stable tool use.

  3. (3)

    连续冗余：由于丢失先前操作而导致的长上下文重复引入了不良的 SFT 监督Continuous Redundancy: Long-context repetition caused by losing track of prior actions introduces undesirable SFT supervision(Xiao et al. 2025)。因此，轨迹 B 应被排除，因为它重复相同的定位动作而没有获得新信息。. Accordingly, Trajectory B should be excluded because it repeats the same localization action without obtaining new information.

  4. (4)

    Git Hacking：基于泄漏的捷径将作弊行为引入 SFT 监管Git Hacking: Leakage-based shortcuts introduce cheating behaviors into SFT supervision(Song et al. 2026; Tao et al. 2026)。轨迹 B 不适合 SFT，因为它从版本历史记录中检索目标修复信息。. Trajectory B is unsuitable for SFT because it retrieves target repair information from version history.

  5. (5)

    结果质量：SFT 应支持最少但足够的补丁，以降低回归风险Result Quality: SFT should favor minimal yet sufficient patches to reduce regression risks(Chen and Jiang 2025)。轨迹A遵循这个原则，而轨迹B则修改了额外的不必要的文件。. Trajectory A follows this principle, whereas Trajectory B modifies additional unnecessary files.

段视图。Segment View.即使在轨迹级别评估为高质量的轨迹仍可能包含对 SFT 价值有限的段Even a trajectory assessed as high-quality at the trajectory level may still contain segments of limited value for SFT(Xiong et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2025a; Deng et al. 2025b)。第 2 部分体现了这种低价值行为。它的步骤成功执行，但该段对最终修复没有贡献，因此不适合监督。我们评估语义片段而不是单个步骤，因为解决问题的行为通常跨越多个行动和观察，应一起评估这些行动和观察以确定其意图、结果和贡献。. Segment 2 exemplifies such low-value behavior. Its steps execute successfully, but the segment does not contribute to the final fix, making it unsuitable for supervision. We assess semantic segments rather than individual steps because a problem-solving behavior often spans multiple actions and observations that should be evaluated together to determine its intent, outcome, and contribution.

这些观察结果表明，高质量的 SFT 数据应该是紧凑且低噪声的，为模型可以可靠地学习提供了证明These observations suggest that high-quality SFT data should be compact and low-noise, providing demonstrations that models can reliably learn from(Chen et al. 2024; Liu et al. 2024). 为此，我们建议To this end, we proposeSWE-Prime，一种多粒度、两阶段的数据选择方法，从轨迹级别到语义段级别逐步过滤训练数据。, a multi-granularity, two-stage data selection method that progressively filters training data from the trajectory level to the semantic segment level.具体来说，第一阶段在轨迹级别运行，以选择成功轨迹的高质量且具有代表性的子集。第 2 阶段在语义分段级别运行，以识别保留轨迹内的高价值行为。 在 SFT 期间，所有片段都保留在序列中以保留上下文，而只有选定的片段才会造成损失。Specifically, Stage 1 operates at the trajectory level to select a high-quality and representative subset of successful trajectories. Stage 2 operates at the semantic segment level to identify high-value behaviors within the retained trajectories. During SFT, all segments remain in the sequence to preserve context, while only selected segments contribute to the loss.

我们评估We evaluateSWE-Prime基于两个代表性基准测试：SWE-Bench Pro 和 SWE-Bench Verified。在所选的 10% 子集上训练的模型on two representative benchmarks, SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified. Models trained on the 10% subset selected bySWE-Prime与在所有成功轨迹上训练的模型相比，分别实现高达 12.2% 和 24.2% 的相对增益。achieve relative gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2% over models trained on all successful trajectories, respectively.

我们的主要贡献总结如下：Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

  • •

    我们强调，先前的工作在很大程度上忽视了成功轨迹之间数据质量的差异。We highlight that prior work largely overlooks differences in data quality among successful trajectories.

  • •

    我们引入语义片段作为行为连贯的单元，用于长视野轨迹中的细粒度监督质量评估，而不是孤立的步骤。We introduce semantic segments as behaviorally coherent units for fine-grained supervision-quality assessment in long-horizon trajectories, rather than isolated steps.

  • •

    我们建议We proposeSWE-Prime，一种多粒度、两阶段方法，旨在为编码代理 SFT 提供紧凑、低噪声和信息丰富的监督。, a multi-granularity, two-stage method designed to provide compact, low-noise, and informative supervision for coding-agent SFT.

  • •

    通过对三个模型和两个基准的广泛实验，我们证明了Through extensive experiments across three models and two benchmarks, we demonstrate thatSWE-Prime在仅使用 10% 的轨迹的情况下，在完整数据集上显着优于 SFT。substantially outperforms SFT on the full dataset while using only 10% of the trajectories.

相关工作Related Work

软件问题解决Software Issue Resolution

软件问题解决需要编码代理为以自然语言描述的存储库级问题生成修复补丁。解决此类问题涉及了解存储库上下文并迭代地查找相关代码、实施更改以及验证生成的补丁是否可以解决问题而不需要倒退现有功能Software issue resolution requires coding agents to generate repair patches for repository-level issues described in natural language. Addressing such issues involves understanding repository context and iteratively locating relevant code, implementing changes, and validating that the resulting patch resolves the issue without regressing existing functionality(Jimenez et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2024; Tao et al. 2024; Zheng et al. 2025; Zhang et al. 2024; Xia et al. 2025; Jiang et al. 2026).

编码代理的训练数据Training Data for Coding Agents

编码代理的 SFT 依赖于基于代码存储库、工具反馈和执行信号的长视野交互轨迹。因此，现有的工作重点是扩展可执行任务的构建和经过测试验证的轨迹的收集。可执行任务通常是根据现实问题、合成错误或代码提交构建的SFT of coding agents relies on long-horizon interaction trajectories grounded in code repositories, tool feedback, and execution signals. Accordingly, existing work has focused on scaling the construction of executable tasks and the collection of test-verified trajectories. Executable tasks are commonly constructed from real-world issues, synthetic bugs, or code commits(Yang et al. 2025b; Jain et al. 2025)。例如，SWE-Gym 从 GitHub 问题构建可执行环境并收集经过测试验证的轨迹. SWE-Gym, for example, constructs executable environments from GitHub issues and collects test-verified trajectories(Pan et al. 2024)。通过可执行验证、软验证信号或基于执行结果和轨迹属性的过滤器来识别和保留成功的轨迹. Successful trajectories are identified and retained through executable validation, soft verification signals, or filters based on execution outcomes and trajectory attributes(Shen et al. 2026; Song et al. 2026; Liang et al. 2026)。例如，SWE-Factory 跨多种编程语言自动化环境构建和任务验证. For instance, SWE-Factory automates environment construction and task verification across multiple programming languages(Guo et al. 2025)。在这些努力中，SWE-Lego 在数据构建后应用了额外的过滤，从训练损失中排除工具调用失败的步骤. Among these efforts, SWE-Lego applies additional filtering after data construction by excluding steps with failed tool calls from the training loss(Tao et al. 2026).

然而，仅任务成功和明确的错误信号不足以识别高质量的监督。在轨迹层面，成功的演示仍然可能表现出不可靠的过程或不集中的补丁；在细分层面，没有明显错误的行为可能仍然是多余的、不相关的或有风险的However, task success and explicit error signals alone are insufficient for identifying high-quality supervision. At the trajectory level, successful demonstrations may still exhibit unreliable processes or unfocused patches; at the segment level, behaviors without explicit errors may still be redundant, irrelevant, or risky(Xiong et al. 2024; Chen et al. 2025b; Chen et al. 2025a; Wang et al. 2025a; He et al. 2026)。为了弥补这些差距，. To bridge these gaps,SWE-Prime在轨迹和语义分段级别上应用质量感知选择，将焦点从单独的任务成功转移到完整轨迹及其行为的监督价值。applies quality-aware selection at both the trajectory and semantic-segment levels, shifting the focus from task success alone to the supervision value of complete trajectories and the behaviors within them.

SWE-Prime

概述Overview

如图所示As illustrated in Figure2, SWE-Prime是一种多粒度、两阶段的方法，可从成功的软件问题解决轨迹中逐步选择 SFT 监督。第 1 阶段选择高质量且有代表性的轨迹，第 2 阶段则识别其中的高价值语义片段。在 SFT 过程中，完整的轨迹被保留作为上下文，而只有选定的片段会造成损失。is a multi-granularity, two-stage method that progressively selects SFT supervision from successful software issue-resolution trajectories. Stage 1 selects high-quality and representative trajectories, while Stage 2 identifies high-value semantic segments within them. During SFT, complete trajectories are retained as context, while only selected segments contribute to the loss.

第一阶段：轨迹级选择Stage 1: Trajectory-Level Selection

第一阶段通过共同考虑三个维度来执行轨迹级别选择：过程质量、结果质量和数据代表性。Stage 1 performs trajectory-level selection by jointly considering three dimensions: process quality, result quality, and data representativeness.

过程质量评估。Process Quality Assessment.

我们的流程质量评估检查成功的轨迹是否提供了良好的解决问题的示范。我们使用从交互日志中观察到的四个互补信号来操作它：通过观察-编辑-验证的工作流程基础、通过工具调用成功的执行可靠性、通过连续冗余检测的交互效率以及通过 Git 黑客检测的行为合法性。这些信号共同覆盖了流程质量的互补层，将个体行为的有效性与整体问题解决轨迹的连贯性联系起来，以评估其对 SFT 监督的适用性。Our process-quality assessment examines whether a successful trajectory provides a sound problem-solving demonstration. We operationalize it using four complementary signals observable from interaction logs: workflow grounding through observe-edit-verify, execution reliability through tool-call success, interaction efficiency through continuous-redundancy detection, and behavioral legitimacy through Git-hacking detection. Together, these signals cover complementary layers of process quality, connecting the validity of individual actions with the coherence of the overall problem-solving trajectory to assess its suitability for SFT supervision.

观察-编辑-验证解决问题的模式。Observe-Edit-Verify Problem-solving Pattern.观察-编辑-验证工作流程将存储库证据和执行反馈中的代码更改作为基础，帮助模型在 SFT 期间学习系统的问题解决行为An observe-edit-verify workflow grounds code changes in repository evidence and execution feedback, helping models learn systematic issue-resolution behaviors during SFT(Chen, Ma, and Jiang 2026)。我们设定. We setSworkflow=1S_{\mathrm{workflow}}=1如果轨迹在第一次编辑之前检查存储库并在最终编辑后通过测试或检查来验证补丁，否则为 0。if a trajectory inspects the repository before its first edit and validates the patch through a test or check after its final edit, and 0 otherwise.

工具调用成功率。Tool Call Success Rate.频繁的工具故障可能会将不可靠的工具使用模式引入 SFT 监管Frequent tool failures can introduce unreliable tool-use patterns into SFT supervision(Yang et al. 2025a)。我们计算每个轨迹的工具调用成功率并定义其工具可靠性得分. We calculate the tool-call success rate for each trajectory and define its tool reliability scoreStoolS_{\mathrm{tool}}作为该速率在轨迹池内的百分位数排名。分数越高表示工具使用相对于其他轨迹更可靠。as the percentile rank of this rate within the trajectory pool. A higher score indicates more reliable tool use relative to other trajectories.

连续冗余控制。Continuous Redundancy Control.在长视野交互过程中，智能体可能会忘记先前的操作，并在相邻步骤中使用未更改的参数重复相同的工具调用，从而可能在 SFT 期间教学模型效率低下的交互模式During long-horizon interactions, agents may lose track of prior actions and repeat the same tool call with unchanged arguments in adjacent steps, potentially teaching models inefficient interaction patterns during SFT(Xiao et al. 2025)。我们比较相邻调用的工具名称和参数并设置. We compare the tool names and arguments of adjacent calls and setSredundancy=0S_{\mathrm{redundancy}}=0如果任何相邻对匹配，则为 1，否则为 1。if any adjacent pair matches and 1 otherwise.

Git 黑客攻击预防。Git Hacking Prevention.当代理使用存储库历史记录中的未来修复信息来指导代码更改时，就会发生 Git 黑客攻击，从而将基于泄漏的快捷方式引入 SFT 监管Git hacking occurs when an agent uses future repair information from repository history to guide code changes, introducing leakage-based shortcuts into SFT supervision(Song et al. 2026; Tao et al. 2026)。为了检测这种泄漏，. To detect such leakage,SWE-Prime在代理修改代码之前检查 Git 历史记录操作是否显示参考补丁内容。我们设定examines whether Git-history operations reveal reference-patch content before the agent modifies the code. We setSgit=0S_{\mathrm{git}}=0当检测到此类泄漏时，否则为 1。when such leakage is detected and 1 otherwise.

结果质量评估。Result Quality Evaluation.

高质量的补丁应该通过最少但足够的更改来解决问题，避免不必要的修改，从而增加回归风险A high-quality patch should resolve the issue with minimal yet sufficient changes, avoiding unnecessary modifications that increase the risk of regressions(Mockus and Weiss 2000; Kamei et al. 2013; Chen and Jiang 2025)。对过于广泛的补丁进行训练也可能会鼓励模型在 SFT 期间进行过度编辑。因此，我们仅使用参考补丁来估计适当的修改范围。我们在文件和行级别评估此范围，分别捕获补丁的宽度和大小。. Training on overly broad patches may also encourage the model to over-edit during SFT. We therefore use the reference patch only to estimate an appropriate modification scope. We assess this scope at both file and line levels, capturing the breadth and size of a patch, respectively.

We define the file- and line-level scope scores as

Sfile=min⁡(FgoldFmodel,1),Sline=min⁡(LgoldLmodel,1).S_{\mathrm{file}}=\min\left(\frac{F_{\mathrm{gold}}}{F_{\mathrm{model}}},1\right),\qquad S_{\mathrm{line}}=\min\left(\frac{L_{\mathrm{gold}}}{L_{\mathrm{model}}},1\right).

当生成的补丁没有超出相应的参考范围时，每个分数保持为1，并随着修改范围的扩大而降低。我们将两个分数相乘得到Each score remains 1 when the generated patch does not exceed the corresponding reference scope and decreases as the modification scope expands. We multiply the two scores to obtain

Sresult=Sfile×Sline.S_{\mathrm{result}}=S_{\mathrm{file}}\times S_{\mathrm{line}}.

我们使用乘法，以便补丁仅当其文件范围和行范围都集中时才会获得高结果分数。评估结果质量后，我们将其与四个过程质量得分相结合：We use multiplication so that a patch receives a high result score only when both its file and line scopes are focused. After evaluating result quality, we combine it with the four process-quality scores:

Straj=15​(Sworkflow+Stool+Sredundancy+Sgit+Sresult).S_{\mathrm{traj}}=\frac{1}{5}\left(\begin{array}[]{c}S_{\mathrm{workflow}}+S_{\mathrm{tool}}+S_{\mathrm{redundancy}}\\ {}+S_{\mathrm{git}}+S_{\mathrm{result}}\end{array}\right).

更高的A higherStrajS_{\mathrm{traj}}表明了一条既具有可靠的问题解决过程又具有集中修复的轨迹。indicates a trajectory with both a reliable problem-solving process and a focused repair.

数据代表性评估。Data Representativeness Assessment.

仅根据质量得分来选择轨迹可能会使选择偏向于一些相似的问题类型，从而导致冗余监督和有限的覆盖范围Selecting trajectories solely by their quality scores may bias the selection toward a few similar issue types, resulting in redundant supervision and limited coverage(Liu et al. 2024; Abbas et al. 2023; Zhang et al. 2025a)。因此我们应用HDBSCAN. We therefore apply HDBSCAN(McInnes, Healy, and Astels 2017)对语义相似的问题进行分组，实现集群选择，从而减少冗余并提高跨问题类型的覆盖范围。to group semantically similar issues, enabling cluster-wise selection that reduces redundancy and improves coverage across issue types.

具体来说，我们首先提取与每个轨迹相关的问题描述，并使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 对其进行编码Specifically, we first extract the issue description associated with each trajectory and encode it using Qwen3-Embedding-8B(Zhang et al. 2025b)。然后，我们将 HDBSCAN 应用于生成的嵌入，以对语义上相似的问题进行分组，并在选择过程中单独处理每个未聚类的问题。最后，我们对轨迹进行排序. We then apply HDBSCAN to the resulting embeddings to group semantically similar issues, treating each unclustered issue separately during selection. Finally, we rank trajectories byStrajS_{\mathrm{traj}}在每个问题组内，选择目标预算下排名最高的候选人。选定的轨迹构成了第二阶段的候选轨迹。within each issue group and select the highest-ranked candidates under the target budget. The selected trajectories form the candidate set for Stage 2.

第二阶段：细分级选择Stage 2: Segment-Level Selection

第 2 阶段通过三个组件在第 1 阶段保留的轨迹内执行分段级别选择：分段分块、分段评分和分段过滤。Stage 2 performs segment-level selection within the trajectories retained by Stage 1 through three components: Segment Chunking, Segment Scoring, and Segment Filtering.

分段分块。Segment Chunking.

行为层面的质量评估的各个步骤的范围太窄。单个步骤通常仅捕获一个动作或观察结果，没有足够的上下文来确定其意图和结果。因此，我们将共享共同意图的连续步骤分组为语义段，每个语义段捕获连贯的本地行为，例如在存储库中跟踪符号的使用情况。Individual steps are too narrow in scope for behavior-level quality assessment. A single step often captures only an action or observation, without sufficient context to determine its intent and outcome. We therefore group consecutive steps that share a common intent into semantic segments, each capturing a coherent local behavior, such as tracing a symbol’s usage across the repository.

长轨迹可能会超出 LLM 的上下文窗口，因此我们使用滑动窗口增量处理它们Long trajectories may exceed the LLM’s context window, so we process them incrementally using sliding windows(Wang et al. 2026)。然而，固定大小的窗口可能会在其边界处分割正在进行的行为，从而使最终片段没有足够的后续上下文来确定其端点。如图所示. However, fixed-size windows may split an ongoing behavior at their boundaries, leaving the final segment without sufficient subsequent context to determine its endpoint. As illustrated in Figure3，这种边界截断可能会导致错误的分割和不可靠的分段评分。, such boundary truncation can lead to incorrect segmentation and unreliable segment scoring.

为了解决这个问题，To address this issue,SWE-Prime采用边界感知分块机制。处理完每个窗口后，employs a boundary-aware chunking mechanism. After processing each window,SWE-Prime完成除最后一个段之外的所有段，这在边界处可能不完整。然后，我们将此片段带入下一个窗口，并与后续步骤一起重新评估它，以确定其语义边界。此外，为了保持跨窗口的一致分割，法学硕士会收到任务目标、既定事实和先前窗口中已识别风险的紧凑摘要。这些机制共同产生语义一致的片段，用于后续的质量评估。finalizes all segments except the last, which may be incomplete at the boundary. Then we carry this segment into the next window and reevaluates it together with subsequent steps to determine its semantic boundary. Additionally, to maintain consistent segmentation across windows, the LLM receives a compact summary of the task objective, established facts, and identified risks from preceding windows. Together, these mechanisms produce semantically coherent segments for subsequent quality assessment.

分段评分。Segment Scoring.

获得语义连贯的片段后，After obtaining semantically coherent segments,SWE-Prime进一步评估每个行为是否值得用作SFT监督further evaluates whether each behavior is worth using as SFT supervision(Song et al. 2024; Xiong et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2025a)。我们根据三个标准定义细分价值：对最终修复的贡献、本地可学习性和行为风险。. We define segment value according to three criteria: contribution to the final fix, local learnability, and behavioral risk.

  • •

    对最终修复的贡献。Contribution to the Final Fix.当分段推进问题本地化、上下文收集、修改、验证或错误恢复时，它就会对最终修复做出贡献。A segment contributes to the final fix when it advances issue localization, context gathering, modification, verification, or error recovery.

  • •

    本地可学习性。Local Learnability.我们根据当时可用的信息评估该行为是否提供了清晰且可学习的证据-行动-反馈模式。We assess whether the behavior provides a clear and learnable evidence–action–feedback pattern based on the information available at that point.

  • •

    行为风险。Behavioral Risk.行为风险捕获不良行为，例如不相关的探索、无信息的故障、不安全的操作和硬编码的解决方案。Behavioral risk captures undesirable behaviors such as irrelevant exploration, uninformative failures, unsafe operations, and hardcoded solutions.

在这三个标准的指导下，法学硕士使用问题描述、轨迹背景和参考补丁来评估每个部分。然后它分配每个段Guided by these three criteria, the LLM evaluates each segment using the issue description, trajectory context, and reference patch. It then assigns each segmentsi,js_{i,j}质量分数a quality scoreqi,j∈[0,10]q_{i,j}\in[0,10]并附上理由。together with a rationale.

所有片段都保留作为后续行为的上下文，而训练损失仅应用于选定片段中的助理响应标记All segments are retained as context for subsequent behaviors, while the training loss is applied only to assistant-response tokens in selected segments(Chen et al. 2025b; Chen et al. 2025a; He et al. 2026)。因此，让. The selective SFT objective is

ℒSFT=−1Nsel∑i∑jmi,j∑t∈𝒜⁡(si,j)log⁡pθ​(yi,t∣yi,<t),Nsel=∑i∑jmi,j​|𝒜⁡(si,j)|.\begin{array}[]{rl}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SFT}}&=-\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{sel}}}\sum_{i}\sum_{j}m_{i,j}\sum_{t\in\mathcal{A}(s_{i,j})}\\[-1.0pt] &\quad\log p_{\theta}(y_{i,t}\mid y_{i,<t}),\\[2.0pt] N_{\mathrm{sel}}&=\sum_{i}\sum_{j}m_{i,j}\left|\mathcal{A}(s_{i,j})\right|.\end{array}

实验装置Experimental Setup

研究问题Research Questions

RQ1（有效性）：RQ1 (Effectiveness):效果如何How effective isSWE-Prime提高法学硕士的软件问题解决能力？in improving the software issue resolution capabilities of LLMs?

RQ2（超参数分析）：RQ2 (Hyperparameter Analysis):有多敏感How sensitive isSWE-Prime其超参数，以及所选配置是否可以跨设置推广？to its hyperparameters, and does the chosen configuration generalize across settings?

训练数据、模型和基准Training Data, Models, and Benchmarks

训练数据。Training Data.

我们使用 Nebius 发布的 SWE-rebench OpenHands Trajectories 数据集，We use the SWE-rebench OpenHands Trajectories dataset released by Nebius,11 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/nebius/SWE-rebench-openhands-trajectories其中包含 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 和 OpenHands 生成的 67,074 条轨迹which contains 67,074 trajectories generated by Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct with OpenHands(Wang et al. 2025b)关于 SWE 重新审理问题on SWE-rebench issues(Badertdinov et al. 2025)。其中，32,161条轨迹成功解决了相应的问题。由于我们的研究重点是成功轨迹中的监督质量，因此我们使用这些已解决的轨迹作为初始候选池。. Among them, 32,161 trajectories successfully resolve their corresponding issues. Since our study focuses on supervision quality among successful trajectories, we use these resolved trajectories as the initial candidate pool.

基本模型和评估基准。Base Models and Evaluation Benchmarks.

我们评估We evaluateSWE-Prime三个基本型号：GLM-4.7-Flashon three base models: GLM-4.7-Flash22 2 https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash (GLM-4.5 Team 2025),Qwen3-30B-A3B-指令-2507, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-250733 3 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 (Qwen Team 2025)和 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, and Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct44 4 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (Qwen Team 2025)。所有模型均根据两个软件问题解决基准进行评估：SWE-Bench Verified 和 SWE-Bench Pro。 SWE-Bench Verified 包含 500 个人工验证的任务，. All models are evaluated on two software issue-resolution benchmarks: SWE-Bench Verified and SWE-Bench Pro. SWE-Bench Verified contains 500 human-validated tasks,55 5 https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/而我们使用 SWE-Bench Pro 的 731 任务公共分割while we use the 731-task public split of SWE-Bench Pro(Deng et al. 2025a).

基线Baselines

  • •

    原始模型。Raw Model.我们评估没有轨迹 SFT 的原始模型，以测量其 SFT 前的性能。We evaluate the original model without trajectory SFT to measure its pre-SFT performance.

  • •

    解析轨迹 SFT。Resolved-Trajectory SFT.遵循先前的工作，根据任务级执行结果保留成功的轨迹Following prior work that retains successful trajectories based on task-level execution outcomes(Pan et al. 2024; Jain et al. 2025; Guo et al. 2025)，我们对所有 32,161 个解析轨迹进行训练，无需进一步的质量过滤。, we train on all 32,161 resolved trajectories without further quality filtering.

  • •

    随机-10%。Random-10%.为了评估相同轨迹预算下目标选择的价值，我们对完整解析轨迹的随机 10% 子集进行训练。To assess the value of targeted selection under the same trajectory budget, we train on a random 10% subset of complete resolved trajectories.

实施细节Implementation Details

训练配置。Training Configuration.

按照 SWE-rebench OpenHands Trajectories 发布的训练方案，我们将最大序列长度设置为 131,072，批量大小设置为 32。我们使用 AdamWFollowing the training recipe released with SWE-rebench OpenHands Trajectories, we set the maximum sequence length to 131,072 and the batch size to 32. We use AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter 2019)具有余弦学习率计划和峰值学习率with a cosine learning-rate schedule and a peak learning rate of4×10−64\times 10^{-6}。所有设置都优化交叉熵目标，同时. All settings optimize the cross-entropy objective, whileSWE-Prime仅将损失应用于选定段中的辅助令牌。除了训练数据和损失掩模之外，所有设置都使用相同的训练配置。applies the loss only to assistant tokens in selected segments. Except for the training data and loss masks, all settings use the same training configuration.

评估设置。Evaluation Setting.

每个任务最多允许 100 个交互回合，最大序列长度为 131,072。采样参数遵循各型号的官方默认值。最终补丁在每个基准测试提供的执行环境中进行验证。Each task is allowed up to 100 interaction turns with a maximum sequence length of 131,072. Sampling parameters follow each model’s official defaults. Final patches are validated in the execution environment provided by each benchmark.

RQ2：超参数分析RQ2: Hyperparameter Analysis

分析协议。Analysis Protocol.由于轨迹池中高质量监督的比例是事先未知的，因此我们首先确定Because the proportion of high-quality supervision in a trajectory pool is not known a priori, we first determine the selection configuration ofSWE-Prime在进行 RQ1 中的主要评估之前。我们检查两个超参数。第 1 阶段轨迹保留率控制保留轨迹的数量，而第 2 阶段分段分数阈值控制训练损失中的分段包含情况。我们使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上进行探索性分析，首先检查轨迹保留率，然后在分析分段分数阈值时修复它。before conducting the main evaluation in RQ1. We examine two hyperparameters. The Stage 1 trajectory retention ratio controls the number of retained trajectories, whereas the Stage 2 segment score threshold governs segment inclusion in the training loss. We conduct this exploratory analysis with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct on SWE-Bench Verified, first examining the trajectory retention ratio and then fixing it while analyzing the segment score threshold.一旦选择，所得配置将被冻结并应用于 RQ1 中报告的所有实验。Once selected, the resulting configuration is frozen and applied to all experiments reported in RQ1.

轨迹保留率。Trajectory Retention Ratio.为了隔离轨迹级别选择的影响，我们禁用阶段 2，并直接对阶段 1 保留的完整轨迹执行标准 SFT，所有辅助标记都会导致训练损失。我们的保留率在 5%、10%、20% 和 30% 之间变化。如图To isolate the effect of trajectory-level selection, we disable Stage 2 and perform standard SFT directly on the complete trajectories retained by Stage 1, with all assistant tokens contributing to the training loss. We vary the retention ratio among 5%, 10%, 20%, and 30%. As shown in Figure4(a)，解决率从 5% 保留率时的 46.2% 增加到 10% 时的峰值 50.2%，然后分别略微下降至 20% 和 30% 时的 49.6% 和 49.2%。这种模式表明，保留太少的轨迹可能会限制数据覆盖范围，而包含超过 10% 的额外轨迹不会提供进一步的好处，并且可能会重新引入较低质量或冗余的监督。因此，我们选择轨迹保留率为 10%。(a), the Resolved Rate increases from 46.2% at 5% retention to a peak of 50.2% at 10%, and then slightly decreases to 49.6% and 49.2% at 20% and 30%, respectively. This pattern suggests that retaining too few trajectories may limit data coverage, while including additional trajectories beyond 10% provides no further benefit and may reintroduce lower-quality or redundant supervision. We therefore select a trajectory retention ratio of 10%.

分段分数阈值。Segment Score Threshold.选择 10% 的保留率后，我们对其进行修复并检查第 2 阶段细分分数阈值的影响。所有片段都保持在原来的轨迹上以保留上下文，而只有满足阈值的片段才会导致训练损失。如图After selecting the 10% retention ratio, we fix it and examine the effect of the Stage 2 segment score threshold. All segments remain in their original trajectories to preserve context, while only segments meeting the threshold contribute to the training loss. As shown in Figure4(b)，将阈值从 5 增加到 7，解决率从 46.8% 提高到 53.2%。进一步将阈值增加到 8 和 9，性能分别降低到 49.6% 和 47.0%。较低的阈值可能会保留更多低价值的监管，而过度限制的阈值可能会排除有用的细分。因此，我们将分段分数阈值设置为 7。(b), increasing the threshold from 5 to 7 improves the Resolved Rate from 46.8% to 53.2%. Further increasing the threshold to 8 and 9 reduces the performance to 49.6% and 47.0%, respectively. A lower threshold may retain more low-value supervision, whereas an overly restrictive threshold may exclude useful segments. We therefore set the segment score threshold to 7.

所选配置的概括。Generalization of the Selected Configuration.基于上述分析，我们选择 10% 的轨迹保留率和 7 的分段分数阈值，并在整个 RQ1 中应用此配置不变。如表所示Based on the above analysis, we select a 10% trajectory retention ratio and a segment score threshold of 7, and apply this configuration unchanged throughout RQ1. As shown in Table1, SWE-Prime持续提高所有三个基本模型和两个基准的性能，这表明所选配置在用于确定它的模型和基准之外仍然有效。尽管我们无法提前知道给定池中有多少轨迹提供高质量的监督，但这种一致性表明所选配置在评估设置中的监督质量和覆盖范围之间实现了有效平衡。consistently improves performance across all three base models and both benchmarks, suggesting that the selected configuration remains effective beyond the model and benchmark used to determine it. Although we cannot know in advance how many trajectories in a given pool provide high-quality supervision, this consistency suggests that the selected configuration achieves an effective balance between supervision quality and coverage across the evaluated settings.

RQ3：行为分析RQ3: Behavioral Analysis

分析协议。Analysis Protocol.检查性能如何提升To examine how the performance gains ofSWE-Prime反映在模型行为中，我们从两个互补的角度分析交互轨迹：过程质量和交互效率。 RQ1 确定了解决率的改进，但此结果指标并未揭示模型如何得出解决方案。因此，我们比较了原始模型、解析轨迹 SFT 和are reflected in model behavior, we analyze interaction trajectories from two complementary perspectives: process quality and interaction efficiency. RQ1 establishes the improvements in Resolved Rate, but this outcome metric does not reveal how models arrive at their solutions. We therefore compare the trajectories generated by the Raw Model, Resolved-Trajectory SFT, andSWE-Prime关于评价任务。我们主要关注 Resolved-Trajectory SFT，它使用相同的候选池和训练配置，并将原始模型视为 SFT 之前的参考。如图on the evaluation tasks. We focus primarily on Resolved-Trajectory SFT, which uses the same candidate pool and training configuration, and treat the Raw Model as a pre-SFT reference. As shown in Figure5，流程质量通过冗余度、编辑前观察率和工具成功率来衡量，而交互效率则通过平均交互轮数来衡量。, process quality is measured by redundancy, observe-before-edit rate, and tool success rate, while interaction efficiency is measured by the average number of interaction turns.

工艺质量。Process Quality.训练模型Models trained withSWE-Prime持续改进评估模型和基准的所有三个流程质量指标。与Resolved-Trajectory SFT相比，consistently improve all three process-quality metrics across the evaluated models and benchmarks. Compared with Resolved-Trajectory SFT,SWE-Prime冗余度降低高达 0.188，编辑前观察率提高高达 9.6 个百分点，工具成功率提高高达 0.094。这些更改对应于更少的不提供新信息的重复操作、在代码修改之前更频繁的上下文收集以及更可靠的工具使用。它们在各个指标上的一致性表明，性能增益reduces redundancy by up to 0.188, increases the observe-before-edit rate by up to 9.6 percentage points, and improves the tool success rate by up to 0.094. These changes correspond to fewer repeated actions that provide no new information, more frequent context gathering before code modification, and more reliable tool use. Their consistency across metrics suggests that the performance gains ofSWE-Prime伴随着更可靠和结构化的问题解决行为。are accompanied by more reliable and structured problem-solving behavior.

交互效率。Interaction Efficiency.如图As shown in Figure5, SWE-Prime在所有六种评估设置中，相对于 Resolved-Trajectory SFT，减少了平均交互回合数，减少范围为 4.1 到 12.7 回合。由于这些减少始终伴随着更高的解决率，因此它们不太可能是由于提前终止而导致的。相反，这种模式反映了细分级别选择的作用：通过防止低价值行为导致 SFT 损失，reduces the average number of interaction turns relative to Resolved-Trajectory SFT across all six evaluation settings, with reductions ranging from 4.1 to 12.7 turns. Because these reductions are consistently accompanied by higher Resolved Rates, they are unlikely to result from premature termination. Instead, this pattern reflects the role of segment-level selection: by preventing low-value behaviors from contributing to the SFT loss,SWE-Prime帮助模型学习更有针对性、更高效的问题解决模式。helps models learn more focused and efficient issue-resolution patterns.

结论Conclusion

这项工作研究如何从成功的编码代理轨迹中选择高质量的 SFT 监督，因为任务成功本身并不能确定记录的过程是否适合学习。我们介绍This work studies how to select high-quality SFT supervision from successful coding-agent trajectories, as task success alone cannot determine whether the recorded process is suitable for learning. We introduceSWE-Prime，一种多粒度、两阶段的方法，根据过程质量、结果质量和数据代表性来选择高质量且具有代表性的轨迹子集，然后根据其贡献、可学习性和潜在风险来识别有价值的语义片段。在 SWE-Bench Pro 和 SWE-Bench Verified 上，模型仅在 10% 的所选轨迹上进行训练, a multi-granularity, two-stage method that selects a high-quality and representative trajectory subset based on process quality, result quality, and data representativeness, then identifies valuable semantic segments based on their contribution, learnability, and potential risks. On SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified, models trained on only 10% of the trajectories selected bySWE-Prime优于在整个解析轨迹池上训练的那些，相对性能增益分别高达 12.2% 和 24.2%。这些结果表明，有效的编码代理 SFT 不仅取决于成功的任务结果，还取决于最终监督的质量、代表性和可学习性。outperform those trained on the entire resolved-trajectory pool, with relative performance gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2%, respectively. These results suggest that effective coding-agent SFT depends not only on successful task outcomes, but also on the quality, representativeness, and learnability of the resulting supervision.
